name: Better Search
description: A drop in replacement for the default Add/Edit Records search box that allows for more advanced searching. This module also adds a new search box to the Data Entry page that allows for searching by record ID, instrument, and event.

authors.name: Adam Nunez
authors.institution: UW Madison - Center for Tobacco Research and Intervention
